name: UnitDamaged
note: projectileID is passed after weaponDefID, so attackerID, attackerDefID and attackerTeam each arrive one place later than in 0.81. The arguments are now unitID, unitDefID, unitTeam, damage, paralyzer, weaponDefID, projectileID, attackerID, attackerDefID, attackerTeam.
changelog: add missing projectileID argument to UnitDamaged

name: AllowCommand
note: playerID is passed after cmdTag, so fromSynced moves from the 8th argument to the 9th and a 10th, fromLua, follows. The arguments are now unitID, unitDefID, unitTeam, cmdID, cmdParams, cmdOptions, cmdTag, playerID, fromSynced, fromLua.
changelog: AllowCommand(..., cmdTag, fromSynced) --> AllowCommand(..., cmdTag, playerID, fromSynced, fromLua)

name: Spring.GetUnitCommands
note: The count argument is required. Calling Spring.GetUnitCommands(unitID) with no count raises a Lua error. Pass -1 for the whole queue, or use Spring.GetUnitCommandCount for the length.
changelog: make Spring.Get{Unit,Factory}Commands always expect a second argument

name: snext
note: From 97.0 the unsynced half of LuaRules and LuaGaia had snext as the same function as next (rts/Lua/LuaSyncedTable.cpp), and the engine's LuaGadgets/system.lua put it in every gadget's System table. Removed in commit d083766c74.
changelog: removed `snext`, `spairs` and `sipairs`. These functions can be replaced by the regular `next`, `pairs`, and `ipairs` respectively with no change in behaviour.

name: spairs
note: From 97.0 the unsynced half of LuaRules and LuaGaia had spairs as the same function as pairs (rts/Lua/LuaSyncedTable.cpp), and the engine's LuaGadgets/system.lua put it in every gadget's System table. Removed in commit d083766c74.
changelog: removed `snext`, `spairs` and `sipairs`. These functions can be replaced by the regular `next`, `pairs`, and `ipairs` respectively with no change in behaviour.

name: sipairs
note: From 97.0 the unsynced half of LuaRules and LuaGaia had sipairs as the same function as ipairs (rts/Lua/LuaSyncedTable.cpp), and the engine's LuaGadgets/system.lua put it in every gadget's System table. Removed in commit d083766c74.
changelog: removed `snext`, `spairs` and `sipairs`. These functions can be replaced by the regular `next`, `pairs`, and `ipairs` respectively with no change in behaviour.

name: UnitDefs.commander
note: The engine no longer reads a unit def's commander tag, so UnitDefs[id].isCommander is false for every unit. Games since mark a commander with customParams.iscommander.
changelog: removed "commander" tag (The Commander selectkeys filter is now defunct (ctrl+c hotkey). Lua it, or add a new one that looks for any canManualFire units.)

name: UnitDefs.modelCenterOffset
note: The engine no longer moves a unit's middle by the def's modelCenterOffset. Spring.SetUnitMidAndAimPos sets it from Lua instead.
changelog: remove modelCenterOffset tag (can now be dynamically set with Lua)

name: WeaponDefs.manualBombSettings
note: The engine no longer works out the burst of an AircraftBomb weapon. The engine's own gamedata/weapondefs_post.lua does it instead, but only for a weapon that sets manualBombSettings, the reverse of what the tag meant, and not at all in a game that ships its own weapondefs_post.lua.
changelog: remove of manualBombSettings (backward-compatibility code in weapondefs_post.lua)
